notes.title: v. 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed up the visibility of the water in one of the chest rooms
[*] Fixed a bug where poison pools and ice patches from heavy attacks would spawn in a different spot than intended.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated the art to the Soldier mini-boss windmill attack
[*] Aiming has gotten an upgrade to feel much better
[*] Right thumbstick controls have been updated to make the controller feel better.
[*] The player can now attack by pushing the right thumbstick on a controller instead of having to press "RB1"
[*] Impact has been tweaked. Let me know if y'all see any issues
[*] Optimized the loading process some. It should load faster into the game at the beginning.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v. 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would spawn in laying down
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would die in other rooms after the boss was killed
[*] Fully upgraded items in the store are now selectable, but will have a yellow glow around them. This is to allow the player to see what he gained from upgrading.
[*] Added a death effect to the game so it's less jarring.
[*] Fixed a bug where one room contained an unintended secret passage
[*] Players will now pick up health potions if they use a potion while on top of the collectable potion.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v. 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could press 'Esc' and get stuck after dying
[*] Fixed a bug where the player couldn't click on the discord link in the Main Menu
[*] Fixed credits to properly credit W.F. Smith Leithart.
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch v 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a player stats section in the store to provide the player with better understanding of what stats do
[*] Fixed a bug with Sludger navigation
[*] Fixed a bug where performance was affected fighting the mage boss
[/list]
